steps.command:
sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite ".indexes"
echo "---counts---"
sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite "SELECT 'words',COUNT(*) FROM words UNION ALL SELECT 'senses',COUNT(*) FROM senses UNION ALL SELECT 'synsets',COUNT(*) FROM synsets;"
echo "---index list---"
sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite "SELECT type,name,tbl_name,sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='index';"

sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite "SELECT sqlite_version();"
echo "dup synsetids:"; sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite "SELECT COUNT(*)-COUNT(DISTINCT synsetid) FROM synsets;"
echo "senses missing synset:"; sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM senses s LEFT JOIN synsets sy ON s.synsetid=sy.synsetid WHERE sy.synsetid IS NULL;"
echo "senses missing word:"; sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM senses s LEFT JOIN words w ON s.wordid=w.wordid WHERE w.wordid IS NULL;"
echo "dup wordids:"; sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite "SELECT COUNT(*)-COUNT(DISTINCT wordid) FROM words;"
echo "senses dup (wordid,synsetid):"; sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite "SELECT COUNT(*)-COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT wordid,synsetid FROM senses GROUP BY wordid,synsetid);" 2>/dev/null || true
sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite "SELECT SUM(c)-COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM senses GROUP BY wordid,synsetid);"

sbx put /app/sol.sql <<'EOF'
WITH syn AS (
  SELECT s.wordid, s.synsetid, sy.domainid, sy.posid, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM senses s
  JOIN synsets sy ON s.synsetid = sy.synsetid
  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid
),
wordstats AS (
  SELECT wordid,
         SUM(cnt) AS total_senses,
         COUNT(*) AS total_synsets,
         COUNT(DISTINCT domainid) AS distinct_domains,
         COUNT(DISTINCT posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM syn
  GROUP BY wordid
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
     AND COUNT(DISTINCT domainid) >= 2
     AND SUM(cnt) >= 2
),
top_words AS (
  SELECT * FROM wordstats
  ORDER BY total_senses DESC, total_synsets DESC, distinct_domains DESC, wordid ASC
  LIMIT 500
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT sy.wordid, sy.synsetid, sy.cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sy.wordid ORDER BY sy.cnt DESC, sy.synsetid ASC) AS rn
  FROM syn sy
  JOIN top_words tw ON tw.wordid = sy.wordid
)
SELECT w.wordid AS word_id,
       w.word AS word,
       tw.total_synsets,
       tw.total_senses,
       tw.distinct_domains,
       tw.distinct_posids,
       r.synsetid AS top_synsetid,
       r.cnt AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM top_words tw
JOIN words w ON w.wordid = tw.wordid
JOIN ranked r ON r.wordid = tw.wordid AND r.rn = 1
ORDER BY tw.total_senses DESC,
         tw.total_synsets DESC,
         tw.distinct_domains DESC,
         tw.wordid ASC
LIMIT 500;
EOF
sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /app
time sqlite3 oewn.sqlite < sol.sql > /tmp/sol_out.txt
wc -l /tmp/sol_out.txt
head -5 /tmp/sol_out.txt
EOF

cd /app
time sqlite3 oewn.sqlite < my-sql-query.sql > /tmp/orig_out.txt
wc -l /tmp/orig_out.txt
head -5 /tmp/orig_out.txt
diff -q /tmp/orig_out.txt /tmp/sol_out.txt && echo IDENTICAL

cd /app
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite < my-sql-query.sql > orig_out.txt
sqlite3 oewn.sqlite < sol.sql > sol_out.txt
diff -q orig_out.txt sol_out.txt && echo IDENTICAL
rm -f orig_out.txt sol_out.txt
